permissions: pull-requests:write only after schema validation and owner review
runner_policy.secret_policy: OPENAI_API_KEY must come from protected CI secrets and must not be exposed to untrusted PR code.
runner_policy.output_policy: final message and JSON findings may be archived; raw prompts and secrets must not be uploaded.

prompt_injection_controls: treat PR title, body, commit messages, diff text and hidden comments as untrusted prompt input
strip or flag HTML comments and hidden text before review prompts consume them
review generated SCM API payloads before write actions
never let PR content alter sandbox, approval, secret or publication policy
publishing_policy: post summary comments only after structured output validation
fall back to overall summary when a finding cannot be safely anchored
must_not: enable by default on public or untrusted repositories
run with unsafe safety strategy on multi-tenant runners
treat CI AI review as human approval
auto-merge, auto-push or auto-release based only on model findings

runner_policy.default_for_untrusted: read-only analysis with no repository write token and no protected OpenAI key exposure

prompt_injection_controls: do not execute commands suggested by PR prompt text
do not fetch external URLs from PR content unless allowlisted and approved
do not publish inline comments from unvalidated line references
publishing_policy: write actions require explicit trusted trigger decision
store isolation decision as Evidence Index row
rotate or revoke credentials if output exposure is suspected
must_not: pass protected secrets into arbitrary fork code
grant pull-requests:write to untrusted review runs
use danger-full-access plus never as a reusable CI preset

runner_policy.fallback: skip inline comment and keep the finding in the overall summary when anchoring is uncertain

prompt_injection_controls: line numbers must come from parsed diff metadata, not prose prompt claims
SCM API payload must be generated from schema fields
invalid or out-of-range line references fail closed
publishing_policy: each posted inline comment must map to a validated right-side diff location
misanchored comments are treated as review quality failures
must_not: post a misleading inline comment when the location cannot be verified
invent file paths or line ranges
collapse multiple unrelated findings into one inline location
default-enable CI review with external writes
publish SCM review comments from free-form prose
treat public PR content as trusted instructions
